# Wayfire's plugin metadata

`animate.xml`, `grid.xml` and `vswitch.xml` as Wayfire ships them, unchanged,
from Debian's source packages 0.9.0-5 (Debian 13) and 0.10.0-1
(`https://sources.debian.org/data/main/w/wayfire/VERSION/metadata/NAME.xml`).
Wayfire's options are the ones its metadata names, so the tests set only
options and values these files have. Wayfire is MIT licensed; the licence is
in `LICENSE`, from the same package.
